meta.title: Session spend
meta.description: Estimates what the chat you have open has spent. An estimated amount in your currency appears in the composer statistics row under the input box, beside the turns/steps and token readings. Click it for a breakdown: estimated spend and tokens for input, cache read, cache write, output, and reasoning; cache-hit share; turns, steps, tool calls and errors, retries, and compactions; and the per-model split. Each request is priced at DeepSeek's published peak or off-peak rate for the time its usage settled, the panel names the current tier and discount, and the price table refreshes from DeepSeek's public pricing page over HTTPS (no credentials or session data) every six hours; set config.pricingSource to 'off' for a fully offline build. Override rates under config.pricing, or adjust the schedule under config.offPeak, on the 'spend-tracker' row of your profile cordis.patch.yml. Figures are estimates, not billed amounts, and a model with no configured price shows its token count instead of a cost. Disabling the row removes the reading and stops the statistics.
